records.issue_text: prisma.user.findFirstOrThrow with booking.userId || 0 throws an unhandled 500 error for bookings with null userId instead of a typed TRPCError
records.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, the organizer is loaded via `prisma.user.findFirstOrThrow({ where: { id: booking.userId || 0 } })`.
